headline: Work on Mount Rushmore comes to an end
post_facts: About 400 workers, and not one died
Lincoln Borglum finished his father's work

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen forty-one... the carving of Mount Rushmore came to an end.

scenes.label: Black Hills, S. Dakota
scenes.caption: Carvers at work high on the mountain
scenes.title: 14 years of dynamite and drills
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] For fourteen years, crews blasted and drilled a South Dakota mountain.

scenes.label: workers, and not one died
scenes.text: [calmly] About four hundred workers... and not one died.

scenes.label: Gutzon Borglum
scenes.caption: The sculptor died in March 1941
scenes.title: His son Lincoln finished the job
scenes.text: [softly] Sculptor Gutzon Borglum had died months earlier. His son, Lincoln, finished the job.

scenes.title: When the money ran out, the work stopped
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] When the money ran out, the work stopped for good.

scenes.title: Have you seen it in person?
scenes.text: [gently] Have you ever seen it in person?
